tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Use to evaluate Bizdevo for B2B lead generation, first customers, outbound sales or customer acquisition. Pass {} to get product facts, access options and source URLs. This tool cannot run a campaign or request access.

tools.name: get_public_capabilities
tools.description: Use to find public URLs or check available actions. Pass {} to get public reads, MCP connection details and unavailable actions. The public connection has no company account access.

tools.name: get_public_document

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_facts, get_public_capabilities, get_public_document · Private data: get_public_document · Public sink: get_public_document, plan_cold_email_test · Destructive: get_product_facts, get_public_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_facts, get_public_capabilities, get_public_document · Private data: get_public_document · Public sink: get_public_document, plan_cold_email_test · Destructive: get_product_facts, get_public_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
